summary: @servicetitan/json-render-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled ~728 KB obfuscated file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array dispatcher, single-letter functions such as WV8StW, hc1jfK9, n7gIxM, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and is not referenced by dist/index.js — it exists solely as the preinstall payload. The advertised purpose of the package is a React JSON renderer, which does not require fetching a second language runtime at install to execute an obfuscated sibling script. Executing under the freshly dropped Bun runtime places the payload outside the reach of Node-based scanners at the moment `npm install` runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
